This is to cater to old default CHASSIS_ID"chassis  user can key in

Though this is redundant now but to have code support existing where there are manytest cases which are relying on this CHASIS_ID variable..  So its a WIP and will be eventually removed when all the other test cases are synced to latest which will be done in different commit bit latter .
